## Decision (2026-10-29, supersedes conflicting text above)

**What:** Agents have production read access. Gather the evidence from the dev host with `ssh ovh-monitor "obs-psql \"select 1\""` (read-only `monitor_ro`; one-line SQL). Pull `tier_attempts` for soft_block-class T4 attempts.
**Why:** By policy, missing production access is not a reason for needs-human. The monitor aliases exist for exactly this.
